prompt_text:
Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 2 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 6 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speech_sdk
import os
import queue
import threading

def stream_microphone_audio():
    speech_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    service_region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")

    if not speech_key or not service_region:
        raise ValueError("Please set AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION environment variables.")

    # Configure Azure Speech service with subscription key and region
    speech_config = speech_sdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    
    # Configure audio input to use the default microphone
    audio_config = speech_sdk.audio.AudioConfig(use_default_microphone=True)

    # Create a speech recognizer instance
    speech_recognizer = speech_sdk.SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

    # A thread-safe queue to pass recognition results from callbacks to the generator
    result_queue = queue.Queue()
    # An event to signal when the recognition session should stop
    stop_recognition_event = threading.Event()

    def recognizing_cb(evt: speech_sdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        """Callback for interim recognition results."""
        if evt.result.reason == speech_sdk.ResultReason.RecognizingSpeech:
            result_queue.put(evt.result.text)

    def recognized_cb(evt: speech_sdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        """Callback for final recognition results."""
        if evt.result.reason == speech_sdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
            result_queue.put(evt.result.text)
        elif evt.result.reason == speech_sdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            # No speech could be recognized, or speech did not match any of the recognition patterns.
            pass # We don't yield empty or "no match" results for transcripts

    def canceled_cb(evt: speech_sdk.SpeechRecognitionCanceledEventArgs):
        """Callback for cancellation events, including errors."""
        if evt.reason == speech_sdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            error_message = f"Error: {evt.error_details} (ErrorCode: {evt.error_code})"
            result_queue.put(f"[ERROR] {error_message}")
        stop_recognition_event.set()
        result_queue.put(None) # Put a sentinel value to signal the generator to stop

    def session_stopped_cb(evt: speech_sdk.SessionEventArgs):
        """Callback for when the recognition session stops."""
        stop_recognition_event.set()
        result_queue.put(None) # Put a sentinel value to signal the generator to stop

    # Connect the event handlers to the speech recognizer
    speech_recognizer.recognizing.connect(recognizing_cb)
    speech_recognizer.recognized.connect(recognized_cb)
    speech_recognizer.session_stopped.connect(session_stopped_cb)
    speech_recognizer.canceled.connect(canceled_cb)

    try:
        # Start continuous recognition asynchronously. The .get() method waits for the operation to complete.
        # This operation initializes the microphone and starts streaming audio.
        speech_recognizer.start_continuous_recognition_async().get()

        # Loop indefinitely to yield results from the queue as they become available
        while not stop_recognition_event.is_set() or not result_queue.empty():
            item = result_queue.get() # This call blocks until an item is available in the queue
            if item is None: # Check for the sentinel value signaling termination
                break
            if item: # Only yield non-empty strings
                yield item
    finally:
        # Ensure that continuous recognition is stopped cleanly when the generator exits
        # (e.g., due to an error, a break, or the generator being explicitly closed).
        speech_recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition_async().get()
